descriptionChirho: A proper noun identifying a Levite leader who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel. Appears in lists of returning exiles (Ezra 2:40; Neh 7:43), in accounts of Temple rebuilding (Ezra 3:9), and in covenant/worship contexts (Neh 9:4-5, 10:10, 12:8,24). All 8 occurrences refer to the same individual (or his family). Multilingual renderings consistently transliterate: eng 'Kadmiel', spa 'Cadmiel', hin कद्मीएल, arb قَدْمِيئِيلُ, kor 갓미엘/가드미엘, swa 'Kadmieli'. The prepositional form with lamed (S131198, 'of Kadmiel') is syntactic, not a distinct referent.
